```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment before CDATA and entity reference -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with <tags> and &internal; references.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ENTITY shared 'Shared Data'>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <!ENTITY custom "&shared; - Extended">
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:root" xmlns:x="urn:catalog:x">
  <!-- Multiple processing instructions and comments inside namespaced elements -->
  <?xml-debug level="high"?>
  <x:item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA content section 1
    ]]>
  </x:item>
  <item>&custom;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">
  <!ENTITY beta "α & Beta Entity">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "external.txt" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % parameter-ent "<!ATTLIST section version CDATA #IMPLIED>">
  %parameter-ent;
]>
<?xml-app-info name="validator" active="yes"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/document" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment embedding an entity reference β to test expansion -->
  <section version="1.0">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing nested markup simulation: <section> β </section>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>β</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Level">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Second Level &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY ent3 "Third Level &ent2;">
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)*>">
  %p-ent;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:type="extended">
  <!-- Comment block preceding complex entity usage and CDATA -->
  <record xlink:type="locator" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw data payload with entities like &ent3; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&ent3;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY product-code "PROD-999">
  <!ENTITY description "Standard &product-code; description">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA | details)*> <!ELEMENT details (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-report author="admin" status="verified"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inventory" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block with special chars <, >, &, " -->
  <product>
    <![CDATA[
      Strictly unparsed character data block <product>&description;</product>
    ]]>
  </product>
  <product>&description;</product>
</inventory>
```
